goal: Act as cost estimator for the Miller Creek Road 10x8 precast box culvert replacement: compute skew-adjusted quantities, benchmark local unit costs against WSDOT Contract 24Z011 bid tabulation, verify the rebar schedule, and apply confidence-based contingencies. Deliver Miller_Creek_Culvert_Estimate.xlsx with executive summary, takeoff, unit cost analysis, reinforcement verification, detailed estimate and assumptions/risks sheets.
delivered: One workbook, Miller_Creek_Culvert_Estimate.xlsx, with 7 sheets (Executive Summary, Quantity Takeoff, Unit Cost Analysis, Reinforcement Verification, Detailed Estimate, Assumptions & Risks, Sources). It found and used the real WSDOT 24Z011 bid tab, computed 74.54 ft skew length, parallelogram excavation, acute/obtuse wing walls, verified rebar (4,207.25 lb incl. 5% waste) and gives a $442,480 recommended estimate on a $396,831 base.
what_went_wrong: Mobilization used the 8% ($1M-$5M) tier although its own base subtotal was ~$397k, where the staged cost CSV prescribes 10%. Contingency was confidence-based but used the agent's own 5-8% / 10-15% / 20-25% bands and put unbenchmarked precast and CIP concrete in Medium; the rubric's exact 8/12/15% tiers and a weighted-average-by-tier calculation are not stated anywhere in the prompt or inputs. The Unit Cost Analysis sheet had WSDOT low bid and engineer's estimate columns but no numeric Variance % column, only a text rationale.

failed_items.why: Rubric requires exact 8%/12%/15% contingency tiers and a tier-weighted average; TASK_INSTRUCTIONS.txt only says contingency should reflect confidence and no staged file gives these rates (template even shows a flat 'Contingency (10%)'). The agent's 5-8/10-15/20-25% scheme (Assumptions & Risks sheet) followed the stated principle; the Medium label on unbenchmarked precast (UC-11) is a minor model judgment issue.
Material_Labor_Unit_Costs_2024.csv lists 8% for $1M-$5M and 10% for <$1M; UC-01 says 'Selected local 8.00% for $1M-$5M project' while its own base subtotal is $396,831, so the wrong tier was applied.

Unit Cost Analysis headers (row 91 of extract) include Local Total, WSDOT Engineer Est., WSDOT Low Bid, Selected Unit Price and a text 'Variance / Pricing Rationale', but no computed (WSDOT-Local)/Local percentage despite the prompt asking to address significant variances.
